context.topic: An internal product-led workshop where Preserve's 12-role team debates the 9 pain points from the first simulation, agrees fixes with owners, rough cost and real-world tests, and produces a ranked priority list and 30-day plan before Archive 002.
context.time_setting: Late 2026, between Archive 001 and Archive 002 (about 8 weeks after Archive 001 ships); each round is one discussion beat in the meeting series
key_conflicts: faceless mystique vs visible trust and proof
generous refunds and replacements vs thin unit economics and preorder cash
scarcity-led streetwear drop vs plant/gift product identity
speed to Archive 002 vs fixing fundamentals and testing with real people
LLM simulation hypotheses vs real customer evidence (UNKNOWNs stay unknown, only proposals)
